scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../articulate-site.zip && zip -qr ../articulate-site.zip . && echo 'Created articulate-site.zip — upload it in AWS Amplify (Deploy without Git).'
scripts.package:gcp: rm -f articulate-gcp.zip && zip -qr articulate-gcp.zip . -x 'node_modules/*' 'server/node_modules/*' 'dist/*' '.env.local' '*.zip' '.DS_Store' && echo 'Created articulate-gcp.zip — upload it to Cloud Shell and run deploy-gcp.sh.'
